SELECT sti.id, sti.code, sti.approve_status AS approveStatus, sti.transfer_date AS transferDate, sti.approve_user_name AS approveUserName, sti.approve_time AS approveTime, sti.transfer_in_user_name AS transferInUserName, sti.transfer_out_user_name AS transferOutUserName, sti.create_user_name AS createUserName, sti.create_time AS createTime, sti.remark, std.id AS detailId, std.sku_no AS skuNo, std.sku_id AS skuId, std.product_name AS productName, std.transfer_qty AS transferQty, std.remark AS detailRemark FROM sample_transfer_info sti LEFT JOIN sample_transfer_detail std ON std.main_id = sti.id AND std.is_deleted = false WHERE
${params.sqlMap.default}
1=1
AND sti.is_deleted = false
AND sti.id IN
#{id}
ORDER BY sti.create_time DESC
